title: TLS handshake completed but the chain did not validate
rationale: The second C11 emission site. In practice httpx refuses such a handshake and R4 turns the refusal into an ERROR, so this verdict is reachable only when certificate details are recovered some other way. Pinned so that the mapping from `chain_valid=false` to a verdict cannot drift unobserved.

spec.quote: All authorization server endpoints MUST be served over HTTPS.
Implementations MUST NOT negotiate the protocol versions SSLv3, TLS 1.0, or TLS 1.1; certificate validation is required.
spec.verification: paraphrase of BCP 195's recommendations, NOT a verbatim quotation. The instrument's own anchor is the MCP HTTPS sentence above; BCP 195 is cited alongside it in checks_oauth.py and in docs/spec-mapping.md without a reproduced sentence. Confirm verbatim before publication.
